The System Design Primer Motivation Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview. Learn how to design large-scale systems Learning how to design scalable systems will help you become a better engineer. System design is a broad topic. There are a vast number of resources scattered throughout the web on system design principles. This repo is an organized collection of resources to help you learn how to build systems at scale. Learn from the open source community This is a continually updated, open source project. Contributions are welcome! Prep for the system design interview In addition to coding interviews, system design is a required component of the technical interview process at many tech companies. Practice common system design interview questions and compare your results with sample solutions : discussions, code, and diagrams.
